amendment.authorization: User authorized autonomous overnight experiments, best use of both rented GPUs, and paper updates; implementation chosen by operator before held-out scoring.
amendment.reason: Replay-parity failures have led to no-edit proposals. Re-evaluating identical deployed weights under different round names consumes substantial time without constituting enhancement. Preserve explicit repeatability controls and allocate remaining time to a separately versioned batch-aware exploratory study.
deduplication_identity: all actually deployed bfloat16 editable tensor bytes
fixed_scoring_order: identity:64 fresh base +64 identical deployed base, ABBA32 blocks
gripper control:64 fresh base +64 frozen development-selected threshold, ABBA32 blocks
each unique edited incumbent in first canonical-role occurrence:64 fresh base +64 edited, ABBA32 blocks
additional64 base-repeat versus pinned first identity-comparison base rows
amendment.planned_episode_capacity: 320 + 128 * U, U=number of unique edited incumbent deployments
amendment.role_map: Retain all eight original round/finalist labels, mapping each to one unique policy estimate. Shared estimates are not independent observations or measured per-round learning curves.
preserve: all original scientific sources and original 1696-episode plan
every failed capture and charged proposal evaluation
all raw development evidence, candidate hashes and notes
strict no-edit-ineligible gate and selection rules
no retry or reset of discovery budgets
explicit list of original comparisons omitted or shared
amendment.separate_followup: Batch-aware v2 requires a new runtime/source binding, new baseline, disjoint development/test streams, fixed capture contract and parity gate, budgets and editor brief. It is exploratory and not pooled with v1.
amendment.feedback_order: Freeze v2 design/briefs before any held-out outcomes; complete and freeze all planned v2 candidate searches before inspecting v1.1 or v2 held-out outcomes.
limitations: Reduced precision for repeated-policy variability compared with the original nine-comparison schedule
No claim that the amended design is the original unmodified preregistered plan
No guaranteed performance gain from the follow-up
amendment.launch_interlock: Create an otherwise empty owned original final-project path with a marker. The original pipeline will finish and archive all four discovery runs, then intentionally stop at its fresh-root preflight before any old final scoring. A distinct v1.1 runner/root will be used.
